comment: Every continuous control has a CV jack: the six macros and direction in one row, and mix, output and harmony each with a small jack beside the knob. Playback is pitch-quantised rather than freely detuned, so the harmony knob widens a pool of intervals rather than sliding a pitch. The memory modes are buffer = input for oblivion, buffer = old times a retention plus new times the rest for remanence, and buffer = saturate(old + input times an amount) through a DC blocker for sediment. configBypass passes each input to its own output. The maker records that the module implements the Vestigium design document version 0.2 and ships seven factory presets. The panel prints vestigia, memory, recall, age, smear, forget, temper, mode, mem, src, fb, direction, mix, out, harmony, freeze, event, clear, in L, in R, frz, evt, clr, mem, evt, env, chaos and the two outputs, with a display strip across the top. The recollection-mode switch prints its three settings as listen, breathe and dream; the memory-mode switch as oblivion, remanence and sediment.
